q: UPSC Civil Services Online Application Procedure - Registration & Process 7 in 2026?
q_en: How to apply for UPSC Civil Services Online Application Procedure via official portal in 2026?
answer:
Sarkari Seva Overview & Guidance 2026

UPSC Civil Services Online Application Procedure ke liye official portal jobs.delhi.gov.in par One Time Registration (OTR) kare. Educational certificates, caste proof, photo va signature upload kare. Application form submit karke registration card ya fee receipt download kare. Scholarship aur Job notifications ki jankari registered email/mobile par bheji jaati hai. Source: jobs.delhi.gov.in

Aavedan Prakriya - Step by Step Process

  • Official portal https://jobs.delhi.gov.in par visit kare.
  • Apna Mobile Number aur OTP dalkar authentication complete kare.
  • Form me zaroori jankari jaise Name, Address, Aadhaar Details, Bank Passbook bhare.
  • Scanned copies of required documents upload kare aur eKYC verify kare.
  • NetBanking / UPI / SBI ePay se prescribe fees pay kare aur acknowledgement slip save kare.

Zaroori Documents List (Required Proofs)

  • Aadhaar Card (Mobile Number Linked)
  • Voter ID Card / Domicile Certificate / Address Proof
  • Income Certificate & Bank Passbook Copy
  • Recent Passport Size Photograph

Helpline & Official Source

Kuch bhi samasya hone par official portal https://jobs.delhi.gov.in par Grievance section check kare ya Toll-Free Number 1800-11-0001 par call kare. Source: https://jobs.delhi.gov.in
